paragraphs: Rabbi Yose bar Ilai: Rabbi Levi transmitted in his name, Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 6. Rabbi Yosef son of Rav Ilai objects to Rav Mesharshaya [the cited passage reverses the roles]: Sukkah 26a. Rabbi Pinchas in Rabbi Yosah bar Ilai’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Megillah 1:14.
